PROCEDURE TO ADDRESS PARKS & RECREATION COMMISSION:
If you wish to address the Parks & Recreation Commission, please complete a Speaker
Request Form, indicating the agenda item number and submit it to the Secretary.  T here
w ill b e a m axim um 30 -m inut e p eriod fo r c om m ents on any sub jec t w ith a 3- minute time
limit on each speaker, unless waived by Commission. You have the opportunity to
address the Parks & Recreation Commission at the following times:

  •  AGENDA ITEM  - at the time the Parks & Recreation Commission considers the
  agenda item ; and

  •  NON - AGENDA ITEM  - at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while
  the Parks & Recreation Commission values your comments, pursuant to the Brown
  Act, the Commission cannot take action on any item not listed on the agenda.

The listing of any item on the agenda includes the authority of the Commission to take
action on such item and to approve, disapprove, or give direction on any item.

  1. CALL TO ORDER  – Chair Rosso

  2. ROLL CALL

  3. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  4. PRESENTATIONS

  A. Introduction of new Parks and Recreation Coordinator  s Alexandra
  Alvarenga and Nathaniel Ruiz.

  B. Recognition of Parks and Recreation Coordinator Rubi Ramos  - Ruiz

  5. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA

  The Parks & Recreation Commission will now hear public comments regarding
  items not listed  on the agenda. The procedure to address the Parks &
  Recreation Commission is highlighted on the first page of this agenda.

6. CONSENT CALENDAR

  All consent calendar items may be approved in a single motion as
  recommended unless removed for further discussion. If members of the
  Commission or persons in the audience wish to discuss any matters listed on
  the Consent Calendar, please address them at  this time.

  Recommendation:  approve items  A - B per recommendations

  A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The Parks & Recreation Commission is requested to review and approve
  the Minutes of the Parks & Recreation Commission Meeting of  February
  18, 2026 .

  Recommendation:  Approve

  B. MONTHLY ATTENDANCE/ACTIVITY REPORTS

  The Parks & Recreation Commission is requested to review the Monthly
  Attendance/Activity Reports for  February 202 6 .

  Recommendation:  Receive and file

7. UNFINISHED BUSINESS

  A. BLUE STAR BANNER PROGRAM

  Continuation of review  of the Blue Star Banner program components and
  provide staff with direction.

  Presentation:  Adam Matsumoto, Director of Parks and Recreation

  Recommendation:  Receive and file.

8. NEW BUSINESS

  A. SERENO OPEN SPACE PROJECT CONCEPT DESIGN REVIEW

  Review of the concept design for the Sereno Open Space Project as
  prepared by SWA.

  Presentation:  Adam Matsumoto, Director of Parks and Recreation

  Recommendation:  Provide feedback and recommendations to the City
  Council for consideration.

  B. REVIEW OF DIAL  - A - RIDE TRANSPORTATION SERVICES

  Overview of Dial  - A - Ride services for the 2025 calendar year.

  Presentation:  Jennifer Venters, Department Secretary

  Recommendation:  Receive and file.

  C. FEBRUARY  PROGRAMMING REPORT

  Recap of  recreation programming including:  sports , Stars Club, LEAD
  p rogram, Park Maintenance and Urban Forestry  Divisions .

  Presentation:  Adam Matsumoto, Director of Parks and Recreation

  Recommendation:  Receive and file.

9. ADDITIONAL  PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS NOT LISTED ON THE
  AGENDA

  If a member of the audience would like to address the Commission on any
  item, which does not appear on the agenda, please do so at this time. Please
  fill out a speaker request form and present to the Secretary.

12. ADJOURNMENT

Notice: Staff reports or written documentation relating to each item of business
of this Agenda are available for viewing on the City’s website at
http://www.templecity.us  and are on file in the Office of the City Clerk located
at City Hall, 9701 Las Tunas Drive, Temple City, California, and available for
review during regular business hours.
